results.title: Don't Make Me Bless You
results.overview: Don't Make Me Bless You is a gripping urban drama about Raine, a salon owner who falls for Dre, a charming ex-con rebuilding his life after prison. a dangerous cycle of control and violence, forcing Raine to confront the truth about love.

results.title: The Gesture Between Us
results.overview: Since founding the physical theatre company Dos à Deux, Artur and André have made the camera their constant companion, documenting their lives, their travels around the world, and their creative processes. Over 28 years of rehearsals and touring, the award-winning artistic couple has built an intimate archive in which art and love intertwine both on and off the stage. It is from this unique body of material that the documentary emerges.

results.title: Love and Faith – Chica Xavier
results.overview: Chica Xavier’s life was shaped by love, axé, the performing arts, and education. Directed by her youngest son, this documentary offers an intimate portrait of the great Bahian actress, a daughter of Oyá whose life transformed countless others, both on and off screen, leaving behind a legacy of love.

results.title: Sunday
results.overview: Over the course of a week in Santiago, Anastasia tries to maintain a sense of normalcy between work, her friends, and her relationship. But the approach of an inevitable event ultimately shatters the fragile balance that has allowed her to keep moving forward.

results.title: Dennis Tyfus – Eindelijk Op Canvas
results.overview: The Antwerp-based artist Dennis Tyfus is using oil paint for the first time for an exhibition in Rome. Is this a risk, or just the fresh perspective he needs?

results.title: Rang De!
results.overview: In the middle of all noise, one colour feels different.

results.title: Doma
results.overview: Forced to sell her horse to cover her dying father’s medical bills, a young woman risks everything in a final race to save her father and the horse that carries his legacy.

results.title: Seamless
results.overview: Julie Burton's costume shop creates works of art under tight deadlines- working so every piece on every actor appears seamless.

results.title: Dot to Dot: Will I Be Single Forever?
results.original_title: てんてん　ずっと独身でいるつもり？
results.overview: Misaki Yamada, 30 and single, has no clear ambitions. After drifting between jobs and places, she works as a care worker until trouble in love and work upends her life. Shiba, 38, avoids close relationships, but takes in his nephew and slowly bonds with him through Yamada. Shimizu, 46, faces caring for her father after years of putting work first. All three search for where they belong.

results.title: Maps from Within
results.overview: During a drawing workshop, a girl traces on the wall of her room the memory of her sexual abuse; a young woman recalls the night in which the deception of those she once called friends turned into harassment. By sharing the stories with other girls and women, they realise that these are not isolated events but fragments of a shared wound.

results.title: ÌWÉ ÀLÀ (An Ojude Oba Story)
results.overview: Iwe Àlá is a powerful Nigerian drama about a prominent tailoring family torn apart by betrayal and hidden secrets. Set during the grand Ojude Oba festival

results.title: My Type
results.overview: Inspired by a true story, two twenty-somethings whose shared experience with Type 1 Diabetes sparks an unexpected love connection.

results.title: Thus Spoke Chatergil Potter
results.original_title: 查德吉爾・伯特如是說
results.overview: The day Father Chatergil Potter left his room, he shed his duty as a Father. Though his body was frail and his mind slow, it was enough to finally experience the tangible world. He sought to understand folly, dreams, and what it truly means to be human—right down to the simple taste of a hearty meal.

results.title: Love at What Co$t
results.overview: A single mother secretly working as a stripper meets a charming music producer whose hidden past pulls her family into a dangerous world of jealousy, deceit, and crime, testing what she'll sacrifice for love.

results.title: Noise
results.overview: A first-time raver enters an underground club searching for escape, but the night descends into terror.

results.title: Девочки учатся бриться
results.overview: The late 1990s. Best friends Misha and Taya dream of escaping the small coastal town where adults have long since decided what their future should be. The brash Misha falls in love with a new teacher, while the quiet Taya hides the fact that her parents are planning to marry her off to a foreigner to save the family. Their friendship, through betrayal and pain, becomes a pillar of strength: they understand that growing up doesn't mean running away, but rather learning to stand up for yourself, even if it means being hurt by reality.

results.title: On Different Grounds
results.overview: A divorced billionaire couple are forced to reunite for their eldest daughter's wedding, only to face hilarious complications when the daughter hatches a secret plan to get them back together.

results.title: Dying for Love
results.overview: In 1991 Miami, a young woman secretly dying of HIV finally finds the man of her dreams, and risks the only thing scarier than her diagnosis—telling the fatal truth to the man she loves.

results.title: Before the Dawn
results.overview: Valentin lives with his grandfather Cosmo, a man of fragile health but with a bright spirit and unshakable optimism. Over the course of an important day, Valentin faces decisive moments in which his grandfather’s light silently guides his steps toward maturity, in a story that unfolds as a tender chronicle of daily life.

results.title: Sometimes, I Imagine Them All at a Party
results.overview: Soberly and with restraint, the director reconstructs the attempted femicide she survived fourteen years before. Intense conversations with people from her past provide an external perspective on an act subjectively and objectively impossible to grasp.
